args.sql:
ALTER TABLE employment_and_income
ADD COLUMN financial_stability_index DECIMAL(5, 3);

WITH fsi_values AS (
  SELECT
    e.emplcoreref,
    0.5 * e.debincratio + 0.5 * (1 - (ex.liqassets / NULLIF(e.mthincome * 6, 0))) AS fsi
  FROM employment_and_income AS e
  JOIN expenses_and_assets AS ex ON e.emplcoreref = ex.expemplref
)
UPDATE employment_and_income AS e
SET financial_stability_index = fv.fsi
FROM fsi_values AS fv
WHERE e.emplcoreref = fv.emplcoreref;
